gloss: to get mixed up; to be lost in; to be distracted

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {紛|まぎ}れていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to get mixed up; to blend in; to disappear into
definitions.explanation: To become indistinguishable within a group or situation, often intentionally to hide.

definitions.gloss: to be distracted; to be diverted
definitions.explanation: For one's attention or feelings to be diverted by something else.

examples.japanese: ⟦{闇|やみ}→闇：14528_yami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{紛|まぎ}れて⟦{逃|に}げた→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧。
examples.english: He escaped under cover of darkness.

examples.english: The criminal escaped by blending into the crowd.

examples.japanese: ⟦{騒|さわ}ぎ→騒ぎ：02827_sawagi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{紛|まぎ}れて、⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧なくなった。

examples.japanese: {忙|いそが}しさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{紛|まぎ}れて⟦{悲|かな}しみ→悲しみ：05404_kanashimi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れよう→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧とした。
